name: 学习索引
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity minimalist desktop web app compositional concept, 1440x1000
Primary request: Create a simpler redesign option F, study index, for the Chinese computer-science learning platform 词元研究所. Keep only a subtle science-fiction mainframe character and avoid the heavy red-outline card style entirely.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop app viewport, no device frame, graphite-black editorial workspace.
Subject: a compact 72px icon rail, header with 学习任务台 and a three-style color selector, then a 60/40 content split: current Python task on the left and a three-row learning index on the right; a slim three-agent footer.
Style/medium: polished minimalist product UI, Swiss information design fused with a restrained mainframe console.
Composition/framing: compact icon rail, wide header, one two-column field, one slim footer, broad negative space.
Color palette: near-black, cool graphite, soft white, one selectable ion-cyan accent active; red and amber only inside their selector swatches. No colored frames.
Constraints: minimal interface; no more than two main content columns; no decorative charts, circular gauges, dense telemetry, nested frames, gradients, huge slogan, floating pill clusters, purple, colored panel borders, illustration, or watermark.
